findings.plain_language: Distance of activity centre from target epicentre was lower than all 6 matched non-event windows.
Depth trend was lower than all 6 matched non-event windows.
Combined seismic-energy proxy sat within the ordinary range of the 6 matched controls (above the control median).
Magnitude trend sat within the ordinary range of the 6 matched controls (above the control median).

methodology.description: Prometheus examined the 14 days preceding this qualifying event within 150 km and compared the measurements with matched non-event windows.
